author: Clijmart
body:
Hey,
this post is mostly towards MapDevs.

Well, me and some other semi-mapmakers have been thinking of making mixed mode maps, like 1 wool and 2 monuments, for Atlas.
Our question is, are those maps needed/do they have a possibility to be accepted?

Thanks for helping <3

-Clijmart + Others
